key_terms.الشَّفْعِ: The even numbers; refers to pairs of prayer units.
key_terms.الْوَتْرِ: The odd number; refers to the single concluding unit of prayer.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Shaf and Witr in Islamic night prayer?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarly tradition, this phrase from Surah Al-Muddaththir is interpreted as a divine command to maintain consistency in worship, specifically referring to the night prayer (Tahajjud) which typically concludes with the Witr prayer. This structure emphasizes the spiritual discipline of offering prayers in pairs followed by a singular closing unit, reinforcing the concept of devotion during the quiet hours of the night. The emphasis on 'pairs' (shaf') also alludes to the general prophetic practice of praying in twos, a norm upheld by the Ahl al-Bayt.
